constraints: Offline synchronous metadata call; immutable UTF-8 bytes up to 65536 and depth 8.
Closed v1 policy, safe integer tokens, complete key metadata, external content pin and caller-trusted time/revision floors.
No hardware target, deadline, service SLA, persistence or authorization behavior is specified.
alternatives: Python standard JSON token/pair hooks and native-backed hashlib.
Java/Kotlin Jackson streaming parser with explicit lexical and duplicate checks.
Rust Serde with explicit policy validation and lexical parity.
CUE configuration validation with a separately evidenced raw-byte admission boundary.
rationale: Retain explicit lexical hooks and immutable snapshots; expose the existing complete policy validator without deriving policy admission from individual passport success.
Candidate documentation supports alternatives but does not establish a material improvement for this bounded offline contract. No comparative performance ranking is claimed.
No new language, custom tokenizer or cryptographic algorithm is justified by the actual requirements. Installed tooling and rewrite cost are not selection criteria.
limits: A checksum from the same untrusted sender does not authenticate a policy. The expected pin must be provisioned independently.
No floor persistence, enrollment, same-revision conflict detection across calls, key ownership proof or live revocation discovery.
Constructible result metadata never grants execution or motion authority or qualifies evidence.
No MLS, CNSA, availability, deterministic deadline or physical qualification.
